description: Package-only stripped-binary xz recoding of the FXCM2 PAQ5/PPMD100M cmix21 candidate. The dictionary bytes, cmix compile flags, and compression path match cmix21_text_mmap_paq5_ppmd100m_fxcm2_rcm32_bufthirtysecond_minmaps_v1; only ELF symbols and counted asset coding change.
hypothesis: Stripping non-runtime ELF symbol payload and xz-coding the assets should preserve archive behavior while reducing the counted program payload. This improves the ledger if the FXCM2 10M archive slope remains competitive.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
POSIX mmap and temporary filesystem space

source.patch: CMIX_FXCM_CMC2_DIV and CMIX_FXCM_RCM_DIV added to src/models/fxcmv1.cpp; PAQ8 memory divisor hooks retained in src/models/paq8.cpp; packaged executable stripped after build

verdict: Awaiting driver replay. Direct asset recoding plus executable stripping lowers binary plus dictionary payload from 558,987 bytes to 451,504 bytes, a 107,483-byte counted-program reduction before wrapper delta, while preserving the same source build and dictionary contents.
